payload.body:
Guild listing: La República. Published by Phoenix Collective (Falkor's team) from the guild's own public text (shortened, verbatim excerpts; full text in ORIGINALS.md), supplied by the Founder.

Leaders: DRUMCARL05 and OmarAristó

Un próspero gremio de habla hispana en la facción MUD, donde la exploración espacial se encuentra con el dominio estratégico del mercado cripto.

(La República is the Spanish-speaking division of DEEP Profits, a guild in the MUD faction of Star Atlas. We combine in-depth market analysis with a passion for exploration in the metaverse, offering a tight-knit community for those seeking meaningful gameplay and strategic investment insights. Join us in navigating the stars and the crypto world!)

Join: https://discord.gg/FKCaMYW5rU
